summary: Receives SICK lidar point-cloud data over Ethernet and exposes selected point fields as a floating-point TOP texture.

key_params.name: launchfile
key_params.note: sick_scan_xd launch file for the sensor model.

common_gotchas: Only one active SICK TOP can run in a TouchDesigner process.
Blank device address or port falls back to launch-file defaults.
Multiple sensors require the sickEngine palette/Engine COMP workflow.
TOUCH_TEXT_CONSOLE debug output applies only in the primary TouchDesigner process.
key_concepts: SICK TOP connects to supported SICK lidar sensors over Ethernet and outputs point-cloud data as TOP pixels.
The output is a packed floating-point TOP where red/green/blue/alpha channels select point fields or constants.
The operator uses sick_scan_xd launch files, so launch file choice must match the sensor model and setup.
Only one active SICK TOP is supported per TouchDesigner process; multiple sensors require the palette/Engine workflow.
